name: Woodpaw Hills
summary: In southeastern Feralas, silithid swarms and mountain giants press into Woodpaw Hills. The Woodpaw gnolls have lost ground in their old territory.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Stronghold
sections.body:
Woodpaw gnolls hold the forests of Woodpaw Hills, though their grip on the slopes has weakened. Silithid swarmers broke through the earth at the Writhing Deep, southeast of the hills, and drove the clan back. Their chieftains have retreated deeper into Woodpaw Den.

Mountain giants also roam these woods. They were summoned from the mountains during the Third War to repel the Burning Legion. Now they crush travelers and Horde interlopers who cross their path.

faq.q: Who lives in the Woodpaw Hills?
faq.answer: The Woodpaw clan of gnolls lives in the hills and keeps defensive camps among the woods. Mountain giants patrol the slopes while silithid insects press in from the southeast.

faq.q: Why are mountain giants walking around this forest?
faq.answer: Mountain giants came down from the peaks to aid the night elves during the Burning Legion's invasion of Kalimdor in the Third War. The invasion was broken, but the giants remain in the woods, guarding the wild lands against intrusion.

faq.q: What is threatening the gnolls here?
faq.answer: Silithid swarms are driving the Woodpaw clan from its camps as they carve out hives at the Writhing Deep. The strongest alphas have retreated to Woodpaw Den and fortified their position.

faq.q: Where are the Woodpaw clan leaders?
faq.answer: The Woodpaw Alphas have left the open camps and retreated into the sheltered underground caves of Woodpaw Den as silithid swarms press across the hills.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face mountain giants hostile to you in Woodpaw Hills. Neutral cliff giants dwell near the western coast.
